//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Starter Structure -> Config

Enable Starter Structure.//: Whether Starter Structure is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

shouldGenerateStructure.//: Whether a schematic that's located in './config/serilum/starterstructure/schematics/...' should be generated.

forceExactSpawn.//: Usually player spawn points are in a randomized area. With this enabled, players will always spawn at the set coordinates (at the nearest air pocket).

ignoreTreesDuringStructurePlacement.//: Prevents structures from being placed on top of trees. Any leaf and log blocks will be ignored during placement.

generationIgnoreJigsawAndStructureBlocks.//: Some schematic files might contain jigsaw or structure blocks. These are by default ignored during structure generation.

protectStructureBlocks.//: Whether the blocks from the generated structure should be protected from breaking/griefing.

protectSpawnedEntities.//: Whether entities spawned inside the generated structure should be protected from damage.

playersInCreativeModeIgnoreProtection.//: If enabled, players that are in creative mode will be able to break and place the structure blocks.

playersInCreativeModeIgnoreEntityProtect.//: If enabled, players that are in creative mode will be able to damage protected entities which spawned in structures.

preventSpawnedEntityMovement.//: If spawned entities inside the generated structure should not be allowed to move away from the block they spawned on. Disabled by default.

spawnNonSignEntitiesFromSupportedSchemat.//: If entities from (structure block) schematic files should be spawned when found. These are entities not created with signs.

shouldUseStructurePosition.//: If the generatedStructurePosition config options should be used.

generatedStructureXPosition.//: The exact x position for the generated structure. Used when shouldUseStructurePosition is enabled. min: -10,000,000, max: 10,000,000

generatedStructureYPosition.//: The exact y position for the generated structure. Used when shouldUseStructurePosition is enabled. min: -1,000, max: 1,000

generatedStructureZPosition.//: The exact z position for the generated structure. Used when shouldUseStructurePosition is enabled. min: -10,000,000, max: 10,000,000

shouldUseStructureOffset.//: If the generatedStructureOffset config options should be used.

generatedStructureXOffset.//: The x offset for the generated structure. Used when shouldUseStructureOffset is enabled. min: -1,000, max: 1,000

generatedStructureYOffset.//: The y offset for the generated structure. Can for example be set to -1 if you notice a building always spawns one block too high. Used when shouldUseStructureOffset is enabled. min: -1,000, max: 1,000

generatedStructureZOffset.//: The z offset for the generated structure. Used when shouldUseStructureOffset is enabled. min: -1,000, max: 1,000

shouldUseSpawnCoordinates.//: If the spawnCoordinate config options should be used.

spawnXCoordinate.//: The new X coordinate of the spawn when shouldUseSpawnCoordinates is enabled. min: -10,000,000, max: 10,000,000

spawnYCoordinate.//: The new Y coordinate of the spawn when shouldUseSpawnCoordinates is enabled. min: -1,000, max: 1,000

spawnZCoordinate.//: The new Z coordinate of the spawn when shouldUseSpawnCoordinates is enabled. min: -10,000,000, max: 10,000,000

shouldUseSpawnCoordOffsets.//: If the spawnCoordOffset config options should be used.

spawnXCoordOffset.//: The X coordinate offset of the spawn when shouldUseSpawnCoordOffsets is enabled. min: -1,000, max: 1,000

spawnYCoordOffset.//: The Y coordinate offset of the spawn when shouldUseSpawnCoordOffsets is enabled. min: -1,000, max: 1,000

spawnZCoordOffset.//: The Z coordinate offset of the spawn when shouldUseSpawnCoordOffsets is enabled. min: -1,000, max: 1,000
